notes: The PDF has no inventory pages, so Element IDs are unknown. Catalogue/design numbers are used where the shape is clear, and 'lego-unknown-*' types where not.

Several pieces are hard to identify from the pictures: the dump-bed wedge pieces (b5, b6), grille (b12), wheel-holder plates (b17, b18) and the step 5 bricks (b10, b11). Their types and attachment points are best guesses.
Step 7 shows a yellow slope hood (b16). I used the 2x2 slope 45 (lego-3039), but its true size may differ.
The numbering skips b7 because the step 4 pieces were merged into b5. Ids are otherwise in build order.
The clear and red round 1x1 plates reuse lego-3005743 (trans light blue) with a colour prop, because the catalogue has no clear or red round plate.
Steps 1 to 3 appear to be drawn upside down. I assumed b2, b3 and b4 sit on the top studs of b1, and the wheel holders sit on its underside.
The four wheels are one repeat, with the attach overrides placing them on the two axle ports of each wheel holder.
